source_quotes: im not sure if previous 4ch power draw numbers are accurate. im doing it now w/the mini3x and getting 1.185A. is that a record power draw driving mode?

according to the display, i think timelapse mode only works with 2ch front/rear. i think telephoto and cabin are not saving, but i do see the cabin cam leds on so it looks like its working either way. the power draw in 4ch timelapse mode looks to be 589 mA. is that the same as before? if not, update our numbers with these ones

scope: Explicit owner retest corrects current driving and timelapse only, superseding earlier 964 mA / 12.1464 W driving and 632 mA / 7.9632 W timelapse; original dossiers remain immutable history. Collision idle 44 mA / 0.5544 W and event recording 935 mA / 11.781 W remain current and unchanged. Installed front/telephoto/rear/MINI3X cabin (4 cameras). Owner tentatively reports front/rear indicated on the timelapse display and telephoto/cabin not seen saving; no clip verification establishes active recording views. Cabin LEDs being on does not prove saved footage. Whole-system supply-DC measurement, not isolated camera consumption. Main firmware 8.0.0.23 observed in fresh physical-card tracklog; MINI3X 9.0.1.10 observed in paired current-card product logs, not intrinsic clip metadata. Rear 9.0.0.17 belongs only to older cohort; current rear version unknown. 12.6 V and DC009 carried from standing current owner-test context, not restated in these messages. Cloud off belongs to earlier context; current connectivity unknown. Watts derived from current with Decimal. No capture FPS/SPF, wake/start timing or definitive recorded roles inferred.
